quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of modern training and load management on player injuries
quotes.excerpt: We had way more strength training and now guys are being taught to stay afloat work
quotes.quote: We had way more strength training and now guys are being taught to stay afloat work instead of true strength work. You are maintaining strength instead of gaining strength. When you are doing band work, no one is saying that is a problem, but at the same time, I bet you if I went to these young guys and asked them do you know what an Olympic lift is, they would be like I don't know what that is.
